title: Product and iterated derived internal bars, with augmentation normalization
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], and let $G,H$ be profinite groups. Use the Grothendieck abelian categories $\mathcal A_1(A),\mathcal A_G(A),\mathcal A_{G\times H}(A)$ of internal modules with condensed-group actions and the exact inflation adjunctions of [lem-sfb-condensed-product-action-inflation]. Let $N$ be any $G\times H$-equivariant internal $A$-module, in degree zero. All derived functors are ordinary K-injective derived functors [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories]. Write $A[P]$ for the free internal $A$-module on the condensed set represented by a profinite set $P$, and $R\underline{\operatorname{Hom}}_A$ for internal module Hom derived in its second variable. For $a,b\ge0$ form the derived bicosimplicial bar with terms
$$B^{a,b}(N)=R\underline{\operatorname{Hom}}_A(A[G^a\times H^b],N),$$
with the $G$- and $H$-inhomogeneous bar faces (first faces act on $N$) and degeneracies. Its totalization uses compatible nonnegative resolutions, with differential $d_G+(-1)^a d_H+(-1)^{a+b}d_{\rm res}$. Write $\operatorname{Tot}_\Delta$ for the totalization of its diagonal, whose degree $n$ term is identified with $R\underline{\operatorname{Hom}}_A(A[(G\times H)^n],N)$ by reordering coordinates.
There are natural derived identifications
$$\operatorname{Tot}_\Delta B(N)\cong R\Gamma_{G\times H}(N[0]),\qquad
\operatorname{Tot}_a\operatorname{Tot}_b B^{a,b}(N)\cong R\Gamma_G\bigl(R\Gamma_H^G(N[0])\bigr),$$
where the inner invariants retain the $G$-action. The diagonal-to-iterated comparison given by the augmented product group nerve and its two successive augmentations, with $H$ first and $G$ second, corresponds under these identifications to the right-derived comparison
$$R\Gamma_{G\times H}(N[0])\longrightarrow R\Gamma_G R\Gamma_H^G(N[0])$$
induced by $N^{G\times H}=(N^H)^G$ and the specified inflation adjunctions. These are statements in the derived category of internal $A$-modules, including the comparison arrow. They are natural in $N$ and include either group trivial and $N=0$. No underived continuous-function complex is substituted for derived internal Hom.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-condensed-action-injective-restriction] to choose a nonnegative equivariant injective resolution $N[0]\to I^\bullet$. Its underlying resolution is termwise injective, and $(I^\bullet)^H$ is K-injective in $\mathcal A_G(A)$ and represents $R\Gamma_H^G(N[0])$. Thus the same resolution is admissible for the internal Hom terms and for both successive invariant functors.

source.place: Paragraph (3), formal internal bar input; assembly of Returned proof steps 1–2: sectionwise/internal equivalence, flat represented free modules, exact induction, injective restrictions and H-invariant K-injective resolution.

proof.text: By [lem-sfb-condensed-product-bar-resolution-model], $C^{a,b,q}=\underline{\operatorname{Hom}}_A(A[G^a\times H^b],UI^q)$ is one compatible bicosimplicial resolution model of $B^{a,b}(N)$. Coordinate reordering identifies its diagonal with the product bar, including its first action face. The invariant inclusion $j_D:J=(I^\bullet)^{G\times H}\to D=\operatorname{Tot}_\Delta C$ is a quasi-isomorphism and identifies $Q(D)$ with $R\Gamma_{G\times H}(N[0])$.

source.place: Paragraph (3), formal internal bar input; assembly of Returned proof steps 3–4: common bicosimplicial internal-Hom model, compatible operators, product diagonal and its invariant augmentation.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-condensed-successive-bar-quasi-augmentations] to this resolution. Put $K^{a,q}=\underline{\operatorname{Hom}}_A(A[G^a],(I^q)^H)$ and $L=\operatorname{Tot}_{a,q}K$. The successive invariant inclusions $j_K:J\to L$ and $k:L\to T=\operatorname{Tot}_{a,b,q}C$ are quasi-isomorphisms with the prescribed ordered differential. Since $Q(J)$ computes $R\Gamma_G R\Gamma_H^G(N[0])$, their composite gives the required iterated-total identification.

source.place: Paragraph (3), formal internal bar input; assembly of Returned proof steps 5–7: sectionwise homogeneous Hom complexes, H-then-G augmentations, first-quadrant total comparison and the iterated derived object.

proof.text: The three quasi-isomorphisms just obtained and the K-injectivity from step 1 satisfy [lem-sfb-condensed-product-bar-normalization-naturality]. Hence the augmented product-nerve shuffle satisfies $S j_D=k j_K$. Inverting $Q(j_D)$ shows that, under the two identifications above, $Q(S)$ is the derived inflation-adjunction comparison, represented on $J$ by the identity $I^{G\times H}=((I)^H)^G$. The same lemma gives naturality for every lift, independence of the resolution, and the trivial-group and zero-module cases. This proves the assertion including its derived comparison arrow.
